source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the receptors of taste (PDF 44).

blocks.text: Zaiqa khaas chemoreceptors (kimiyai maddon ko pehchanne wale receptors) mehsoos karte hain jinhein taste buds kehte hain. Taqreeban 10,000 taste buds hain. In mein se zyada tar zaban par ubharon (papillae) ke darmiyan dhanse hote hain. Kuch taste buds gale mein aur munh ki chhat par bhi hain. Taste bud piyaz-numa (bulb-shaped) hai aur baal jaise hisson wale receptor cells aur basal cells (naye receptor cells banane wale) se bana hai. Taste bud ek taste pore (chhote suraakh) ke zariye munh mein khulta hai.

blocks.alt: Zaban aur us par kadwe (bitter, peeche), khatte (sour, kinare), namkeen (salty) aur meethe (sweet, nok) ke hisse. Dabbe mein ghiri papilla se teer papilla ke bare tukre tak jata hai jis ki deewaron mein taste buds hain; doosra teer bare taste bud tak: receptor cells jin ke baal taste pore par khulte hain, basal cells, aur neeche se nikalte sensory neurons ke axons, sab zaban ke epithelium mein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeron ke saath chhote hote jayen: poori zaban, phir ek papilla ka bara tukra jis ki deewaron mein taste buds hain, phir ek taste bud. Taste bud mein receptor cells ke baal taste pore par munh ki taraf khulte hain, basal cells neeche naye cells banate hain, aur neeche se sensory neurons ke axons paigham le jate hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Boo ka zaiqe par asar aasani se dekha ja sakta hai: pehle naak khuli rakh kar piyaz khayen, phir naak band kar ke khayen aur farq mehsoos karein.

Jab khane ya peene ki cheez ke kimiyai madde taste buds ke chemoreceptor cells ko jagate hain to woh apne sath jure sensory neurons mein nerve impulses paida karte hain. Yeh impulses nerves (cranial nerve VII, IX aur X) ke zariye brainstem tak pohanchte hain. Wahan se impulses cerebral cortex ke zaiqa mehsoos karne wale hisson tak bheje jate hain. Cortex is maloomat ko boo aur banawat (texture) jaisi doosri hissi maloomat ke saath mila kar zaiqe ka poora ehsas banata hai.

Insan paanch bunyadi zaiqe mehsoos karta hai: namkeen (salty), meetha (sweet), khatta (sour), kadwa (bitter) aur umami (gosht jaisa lazeez zaiqa). Zaban ke har hisse ke taste buds mein har bunyadi zaiqe ke receptor cells hote hain; kisi hisse mein sirf ek zaiqe ke taste buds nahin hote, sirf hasasiyat (sensitivity) mein thora farq hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke insan mein chaar qisam ke taste buds hain jo zaban ke alag hisson mein ikatthe hain: meetha nok par, khatta kinaron par, kadwa peeche aur namkeen zyada tar sateh par ('zaban ka naqsha', tongue map). Yeh purana aur ghalat khayal hai: zaban ke har hisse ke taste buds mein har bunyadi zaiqe ke receptor cells hain, aur umami paanchwan bunyadi zaiqa hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si cranial nerves zaiqe ke impulses brainstem tak le jati hain?
blocks.explanation: Cranial nerves VII, IX aur X.

items: Taqreeban 10,000 taste buds (receptor cells, basal cells, taste pore); impulses nerves VII, IX, X se brainstem aur phir cortex tak; boo aur banawat mil kar poora zaiqa banate hain; har hissa har zaiqa mehsoos karta hai.
